summary: Vendor helper: lodash toNumber. Returns numbers as-is, NaN for symbols (module 1383 isSymbol), unwraps objects via valueOf (module 351 isObject), coerces non-strings with unary plus, otherwise trims the string (module 1381 baseTrim) and parses binary (0b) and octal (0o) prefixes with parseInt, rejects signed hex (/^[-+]0x/) as NaN, and falls back to +value.
